doc.title: Dave Bailey and John McNeil Interview, 1959-10-25

chapter: Young Tuxedo and Chris Kelly years
title: The 1915 storm and playing with Chris Kelly
summary: Bailey was with his brother's band at the 1915 storm, then six years with Kelly, including Tallulah.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Chris Kelly, the blues trumpeter and his band

blocks.x: Were you playing together when they had the Big Storm or were you with Chris Kelly then?
They had the Big Storm in 1915.
Which band were you with then?

I was with my brother's band then. I had them. I was with Chris Kelly after that. But anyhow, I stayed with Chris Kelly after we stopped traveling, one, two, and all the different places. I played Chris Kelly six years. My brother, John, was in the band, so we played bass. We played together. Six years. And we went to Tallulah. And stayed up there for months. That was our headquarters. We played around different places.
